useAndMine.tooltip: Animates the item while the player holds down right mouse button then left mouse button while aiming at the ground.
useAndMineParticles.tooltip: Visually shows mining progress particles while the player is holding both mouse buttons.
blockHitting.tooltip: Animates the item while the player clicks both mouse buttons.
firstPersonPositions.tooltip: Reverts first person item transformations to match 1.7. Currently, this feature will disable the ability for resource packs to alter item positions, however, this is subject to change in the future.
smoothSneaking.tooltip: Smoothly interpolates the player's changing eye height as they sneak.
thirdPersonSneaking.tooltip: Positions the player model to mimic it's position while sneaking in 1.7. Only viewable in third person mode.
allowMiningCancel.tooltip: Allows the player to pause their mining progress by using an item. This may cause some jarring issues with the mining progress. It's advised to use this feature alongside the "Mining Progress Reset Logic" feature to completely fix those issues.
stickRod: Replace Cast Fishing Rod Texture With Stick Texture
stickRod.tooltip: Replaces the cast fishing rod texture with the stick texture while in third person mode. Weirdly a feature in 1.7.
blockingArm: Third Person Sword Blocking Arm Position
blockingArm.tooltip: Positions the blocking arm in a manner that replicates 1.7.
droppedItemSprite.tooltip: Renders dropped items as sprites. This may increase performance just like it did in 1.7!
mirroredProjectiles.tooltip: Mirrors projectiles so that they face the correct direction! This is a bug in 1.8.
flameOffset.tooltip: Offsets the flame (when set on fire) of the player. Only viewable on your player! This is a bug in 1.7.
oldItemPickup.tooltip: Offsets the item pickup animation to match 1.7.
equipLogic.tooltip: Replicates the equip animation played by switching items within the player's inventory or hotbar.
oldSwingVisual.tooltip: Visually swings the player's arm during the miss penalty. In 1.7, the miss penalty does not affect combat, so this option sort of emulates that behavior but without modifying 1.8 combat.
oldSwingVisualParticles.tooltip: Visually shows particles (mining, criticals, sharpness, etc) during missed hits given the appropriate conditions.
slowUpSneak.tooltip: Makes the sneaking up animation slower to match 1.7
stopLineTranslateSneak: Stop Fishing Rod Line Translation while Sneaking
stopLineTranslateSneak.tooltip: Stops the fishing rod's line from translating down while sneaking. Only viewable while in the third person perspective.
xpOrbPosition.tooltip: Offsets the XP orb's position. This is a bug in 1.7!
fixThirdPersonHeldItemSneakDeSync.toolti: Fixes a de-sync which occurs when sneaking and holding an item. Only viewable from the third person perspective. This is a bug in 1.8.
oldBowRotation.tooltip: Rotates the bow in a manner that replicates its exact position in 1.7.
swordBlockThirdPerson: Third Person Sword Item Blocking Position
swordBlockThirdPerson.tooltip: Gives the sword item the 1.7 sword-block transformations in third person mode.
doubleTapSneak.tooltip: Allows you to double tap your sneak keybind to activate sprinting. This was a bug in 1.7.
framedItemLighting.tooltip: Allows framed items to have lighting applied to them just like in 1.7.
miningProgressResetLogic.tooltip: Resets the mining progress when the player stops holding down their left mouse button just like in 1.7.
oldJumpBoostPotionColor.tooltip: Before 1.8, the jump boost effect had a darkish purple color. Toggling this will reload the game resources!
creeperOffset.tooltip: Offsets the model of the creeper by 2 pixels. This was a bug in 1.7. This feature requires you to reload the game!
goldenCarrotCreativeTab: Show Golden Carrot in Food Tab
goldenCarrotCreativeTab.tooltip: Places the golden carrot in the food tab in the creative mode menu. This option requires a game restart to apply properly!
shadowOffset.tooltip: Offsets the player's shadow to be approximately half of the player's height above the player's eye height like in 1.7.
horseRiderEyeHeight.tooltip: Reverts the player's eye height while riding a mob or a boat to what it was in 1.7.
sleepEyeHeight.tooltip: Reverts the player's eye height while sleeping to what it was in 1.7.
potionEntityOffset.tooltip: Offsets the potion entity's rendering vertically to match 1.7.
playerEyeHeightOffset.tooltip: This feature literally only affects the eating particles and the third person fishing rod line position for other player entities. These two are positioned just slightly higher to match 1.7. The feature's name is an homage to the fact that the player's eye height is 0.12 in 1.7 under certain circumstances, and this value is used in like 2 or 3 places, but is ultimately overridden to 1.62 everywhere else.
zombieVillagerHelmetOffset.tooltip: Offsets worn helmets on zombie villagers by 2 pixels like in 1.7. This feature requires you to reload the game!
swapDroppedItemNormals.tooltip: Swaps the normal values when rendering dropped items like in 1.7. The normals dictate how light bounces off the different flat and extruded edges of that sprite. Intended to be paired with the "droppedItemSprite" feature.
droppedItemsFacePlayer.tooltip: Dropped items will face the player rather than spin like in 1.7. Intended to be paired with the "droppedItemSprite" feature.
projectileSprite.tooltip: Renders projectiles as sprites rather than as models like in 1.7.
swapProjectileSpriteNormals.tooltip: Swaps the normal values when rendering dropped items like in 1.7. The normals dictate how light bounces off the different flat and extruded edges of that sprite. Intended to be paired with the "projectileSprite" feature.
framedItemSprite.tooltip: Renders framed items as sprites rather than as models like in 1.7.
swapFramedItemSpriteNormals.tooltip: Swaps the normal values when rendering dropped items like in 1.7. The normals dictate how light bounces off the different flat and extruded edges of that sprite. Intended to be paired with the "framedItemSprite" feature.
framedItemPosition.tooltip: Shifts items in an item frame back to match 1.7.
thirdPersonPositions.tooltip: Reverts third person item transformations to match 1.7. Currently, this feature will disable the ability for resource packs to alter item positions, however, this is subject to change in the future.
trapDoorItemPosition.tooltip: Reverts the trapdoor item model position when viewed in the inventory, while held, or dropped to match 1.7. Toggling this will reload the game resources!
useAndMineSound.tooltip: Plays block mining sounds while using and item and mining to imiate block breaking.
framedItemRotationOffset.tooltip: Offsets items slightly in an item frame on the 90, 180, and 270 degree marks to match 1.7.
